spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's motivating use cases verbatim — 'Press the touchpad' prompts from type === "trackpad", standard/non-standard classification, and the index-table fallback it replaces — with real edge-detected getGamepads() capture when hardware is present.

interactive.rationale: Per-action bind buttons arm a real rAF press-listener or a simulated capture; both feed the identical labelling pipeline and update index-only vs type-aware readouts live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises semantic labels driven by the real API when a pad is present and a labelled simulation otherwise; the page does exactly that, including the flag-off honest degradation.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers no getGamepads, no pad connected (honest real empty result), flag-off capture (type undefined shows the fallback story), out-of-vocabulary enum guard, and pressing a sim button with nothing armed.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5075054393163776 and the explainer's trackpad use case.

conformance.rationale: The suite's manual trackpad-click-reports-trackpad assertion records this page's canonical contract as hardware-gated instead of faking a pass; executable assertions cover the surfaces the pipeline relies on.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium on both viewports drove the full simulated flow (Fire→touchpad→index 17 type trackpad; Sprint→R2→standard), the honest no-gamepad real-bind path, and the unarmed-press guidance, console/network clean bar the environmental font failure; real-controller capture and flag-on type reads are untestable in this sandbox.

telemetry_health.rationale: prompts-real-capture, prompts-sim-capture-labelled, prompts-no-gamepad-honest, and prompts-no-api-honest are separate asserts; simulated captures are never reported as real ones.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; armed state overrides background (accent-blue) with explicit ivory color at 7.6:1; sim buttons pair ivory background with black text.

accessibility.rationale: Bind buttons carry per-action aria-labels and aria-pressed arming state, both statuses are aria-live=polite outputs, rows are a labelled list, and keyboard operation was exercised.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800; binding rows collapse to single column with full-width >=44px buttons on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Confirm real DualSense touchpad capture end-to-end when the implementation ships
openQuestions.detail: With a physical DualSense and a flag-on build, bind an action from the real touchpad click and verify the type-aware label reads 'Press the touchpad' from live API output (not simulation), and that Chrome exposes the click at the index the demo's simulation assumes (17) — adjust the simulated stand-in metadata if the shipped mapping differs.

openQuestions.title: Consider a persistence/rebind-conflict angle as a future additive concept
openQuestions.detail: A deeper remapping demo could persist bindings and show conflict detection ('trackpad already bound to Fire'), exercising type-based grouping like 'any trigger'. Add as a NEW concept page if built — never rework this one.

guidanceConsulted.query: high frequency live readout requestAnimationFrame polling accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Distinguish simulated vs real content in accessible names and announce state changes via polite live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Sim stand-ins are labelled 'simulated press' in their aria-labels and every simulated status string ends with a 'not from a device' marker; real and simulated statuses are separate aria-live outputs.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid of status cards without horizontal overflow narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Two-column rows should collapse to one column on narrow viewports with full-width controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Binding rows are grid-template-columns:1fr auto collapsing to 1fr under 640px with width:100% buttons; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: pause high-frequency polling when content not visible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not leave high-frequency loops running when they cannot produce results.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The press-listener rAF loop only starts when a pad is actually connected, is cancelled on re-arm, and stops itself the moment a press is captured.

summary: The proposal's motivating remapping use case: index-only labels vs type-aware semantic prompts side by side, with real edge-detected capture when hardware exists and a clearly-labelled DualSense-style simulation otherwise. All hardware-absent paths browser-verified on both viewport classes; real-hardware and flag-on paths honestly recorded as untestable here.
